title: BMR Calculator
description: Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) — the calories your body burns at rest.

faqs.question: What formula does this use?
faqs.answer: The Mifflin-St Jeor equation, widely considered one of the most accurate BMR formulas.

faqs.question: Is BMR the same as calories I should eat?
faqs.answer: No — BMR is calories burned at complete rest. Use the Calorie Calculator to factor in activity level.
